title: stability maps across damage influx, nascent occupancy and rescue allocation
description: 3-d map over (j, nu, chi). continues the low-burden branch in j at each (nu, chi), brackets the fold, records the equilibrium count either side with an independent blind finder, and measures recovery time at several distances from the boundary.
burden_threshold_note: nondimensional damage threshold H: total burden equal to the total rescue pool. this is a MODELLING CHOICE for phase 1, not a measured viability threshold.

resources.note: resource request, not a completion-time promise
